metadata.title: Crystallographic quotients of Artin braid groups and torus bundles over flat $3$-manifolds
metadata.abstract: For $n\geq3$, let $\overline B_n=B_n/[P_n,P_n]$ be the crystallographic quotient of the Artin braid group, with translation subgroup $\overline P_n=P_n/[P_n,P_n]\cong\mathbb Z^N$, where $N=\binom n2$. We prove that every compact connected flat $3$-manifold $M$, considered up to affine equivalence, is the base of a geometric torus bundle whose total space is a compact flat manifold with fundamental group a Bieberbach subgroup of some $\overline B_n$. More precisely, for every $n\geq n_M$, where $n_M\in\{3,4,5\}$ is an explicit optimal threshold depending on $M$, we construct a Bieberbach subgroup $\Gamma_n(M)\leq\overline B_n$ of dimension $N$ and a complete normal subgroup $K_n(M)\cong\mathbb Z^{N-3}$ consisting of translations such that $$ \Gamma_n(M)/K_n(M)\cong\pi_1(M). $$ We also determine which of the associated torus-bundle group extensions split: for the realizations constructed here, splitting occurs for exactly four of the ten affine-equivalence classes of compact flat $3$-manifolds.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 证明十类紧连通平坦三流形均可作几何环面丛的底，其平坦总空间的基本群嵌入适当 Artin braid group 的晶体商；给出依底空间而定的最优 n 阈值及各更大 n 的构造，并判定构造中的群扩张恰在四类底空间上分裂。
analysis.breakthrough: 把所有紧平坦三流形纳入同一 braid quotient 构造并给出最优实现阈值。
analysis.limitations: 依据官方标题、摘要及作者评论的摘要级分析，尚未审读数学证明。分裂计数针对文中构造的实现，不能不经额外论证推广到这些底空间上的所有环面丛。 AI 披露以独立全文核查记录为准。
analysis.priorityReason: 按结论范围、几何关联与方法可迁移性安排阅读；分裂计数针对文中构造的实现，不能不经额外论证推广到这些底空间上的所有环面丛。
